description: This file defines the TraceLoggingCommon class which manages event logging for the Microsoft Calculator application, including methods for logging events at different levels with associated session and privacy data.

classes.name: TraceLoggingCommon
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing event logging for the calculator application, including enabling/disabling logging and logging events at different levels.

methods.name: TraceLoggingCommon
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the logging provider and generates a session GUID.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of TraceLoggingCommon.

methods.name: GetTraceLoggingProviderEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the logging provider is enabled.

methods.name: LogLevel1Event
methods.description: Logs an event at level 1 with session and privacy data.

methods.name: LogLevel2Event
methods.description: Logs an event at level 2 with session and privacy data.

methods.name: LogLevel3Event
methods.description: Logs an event at level 3 with session and privacy data.
